title: Founding of NASA's electrostatics lab by Carlos Gier
summary: Charles Buer tells of Founding of NASA's electrostatics lab by Carlos Gier, about about 26 years ago (c. 2000) at Kennedy Space Center, Florida, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: it was founded about 26 years ago by Dr. Carlos Gier, a physicist who uh spent a summer working at Kennedy Space Center.

plain: Charles Buer, introduced as a NASA scientist on Jesse Michels's podcast, describes the start of NASA's electrostatics lab at Kennedy Space Center in Florida, a lab that studies static electricity and electric charge. He says it was founded about 26 years ago, around 2000, by a physicist named Dr. Carlos Gier who had spent a summer working at the center. The story matters to him as the origin of the lab where, according to the episode, work on a new kind of propulsion later took place.
